footer: Independent tool · Not MassHealth · Sample data
headline: Got a blue envelope from MassHealth?
sub: Take a photo of your letter. We'll show you what it means and help you get your proof ready.
photo: Take a photo of your letter
trust_choose: You choose who sees your papers
screener_note: Not sure the new rules affect you? Start with MassHealth's own screener. Blue Envelope helps after that.
e_deadline: Answer by December 15, 2026. If you miss it, your coverage could stop.
e_asking: They need to know what you did for one month since your last renewal: work, school, volunteering or job training. Or tell them if a reason excuses you.
e_send: Proof like pay stubs or earnings screenshots, a letter from a volunteer group, or a school enrollment letter.
e_how: Online, by mail, fax or phone. Use the contact details printed on your own letter.
read_aloud_working: Reading aloud. If you hear nothing, this browser may not have a voice for this language yet.
read_aloud_unavailable: Read-aloud isn't available in this browser. The real app uses a hosted voice.
photo_got: Got your photo. In the real app, Textract and Claude read it. This prototype shows the X-Ray on a sample letter.
q_sub: Maria's sample answers are filled in. Change them to see the result change.
q2_title: Do any of these apply to you?
q3_title: What did you do last month?
q4_title: When did you last update your phone and address with MassHealth?
ex_pregnant: Pregnant, or had a baby in the last 12 months
ex_caregiver: Care for a child under 14 or a person with a disability
ex_health: A health condition that makes it hard to work
ex_treatment: In a treatment program for alcohol or drug use
ex_veteran: Veteran with a total disability rating from the VA
path_age_title: The new work rules likely don't apply at your age
path_age_body: They cover adults 19 to 64. Still answer your letter by the deadline so your coverage continues.
path_income_title: Your earnings may meet the income rule
path_income_body: One month of income of $580 or more counts, no matter how many hours you worked.
path_school_body: Being enrolled at least half-time counts. A letter from your school is usually enough proof.
path_hours_title: Your hours may meet the rule
path_hours_body: Work, volunteering and job training add up. You need 80 in one month.
path_short_title: You're close. Here's how to close the gap
path_short_body: Add volunteer or training hours, check whether a reason excuses you, or talk to a navigator at your health center.
prove_body: Add screenshots of your weekly pay from DoorDash, Uber, Instacart or your pay stubs. We add up the month for you.
got_screenshots: Got your screenshots. The prototype shows sample amounts; the real app reads yours.
over_580: That is more than the $580 monthly amount.
under_580: That is under the $580 monthly amount.
decides_guide: This is a guide, not a decision. MassHealth makes the decision about your coverage.
earnings_done: Added up from 4 screenshots. Ready to send.
school_item_body: Ask your school's registrar for a letter showing half-time enrollment.
excused_item_title: Proof of your reason, if MassHealth asks
excused_item_body: For example a doctor's note. Your health center can help.
short_item_body: Volunteer or job training hours can make up the hours you still need.
partner_none_title: Volunteer hours from Riverside Food Pantry (sample)
partner_none_body: Backup proof. Send the coordinator a link and they confirm your hours.
partner_sent_body: Link sent to the coordinator. You'll get a text when they confirm.
partner_confirmed_body: Riverside Food Pantry confirmed your March hours. Added to your packet.
contact_warn_body: Letters and texts go to the details MassHealth has on file. Update them so you don't miss the next one.
contact_updated_body: Thanks. Future letters and texts should reach you.
reminders_body: 30, 14 and 3 days before December 15, in your language, to (•••) •••-0142.
share_on_body: A navigator at Riverside Community Health Center (sample) can see your packet and check it before you send it. Turn this off anytime.
share_off_body: Off. Nobody else can see your packet. Turn this on if you want a navigator to check it.
submit_sub: Pick whichever way is easiest. Use the contact details printed on your own letter.
way_online_body: Upload your packet through MassHealth's website.
way_mail_body: Send the packet to the address or fax number on your letter.
way_phone_body: Call the number on your letter and tell them what your packet shows.
help_211: Call Mass 211 for help with food, housing and other needs, any time.
decides_watch: MassHealth makes the decision. Watch for a letter, text or email with the answer.
step_letter_desc: The deadline, the request and what to send, highlighted and translated.
step_questions_desc: Age, reasons that excuse you, last month's activities, contact details.
step_path_desc: Income, hours, school or excused. Earnings screenshots added up.
step_packet_desc: Checklist, partner sign-off, reminders, consent to share.
step_submit_desc: Official channels, plus help from 211 and a health center.
help_understand: I don't understand this, help me
help_ask_placeholder: What would you like help with?
help_sample_note: Here is the sample explanation. MassHealth makes the decision.
stays_on_phone: Your letter stays on your phone
ocr_reading: Reading your letter on your phone…
ocr_done: Read on your phone. Nothing was uploaded.
chat_label: AI helper · can make mistakes · MassHealth decides
chat_talk_211: Call Mass 211 for help, any time.
chat_cap: You've asked 5 questions. For more, talk to a person.
chip_deadline_q: What if I miss the deadline?
chip_deadline_a: If you miss the deadline, your coverage could stop. Answer by the date on your letter. If you already missed it, call your health center or 211 right away — they may still be able to help.
chip_proof_a: Pay stubs, earnings screenshots, a letter from a volunteer group, or a school enrollment letter. Send proof for one month since your last renewal.
chip_help_a: Yes. Your health center has navigators who help for free. You can also call 211. You choose who sees your papers.
chip_decide_a: MassHealth decides about your coverage. This tool is a guide — it does not decide. It helps you understand your letter and get your proof ready.
mic_note: Your browser's speech service turns your voice into text. We don't store audio.
delete_confirm: Deleted from this phone. Nothing was stored on our servers.
town_q: Which town do you live in?
sent_logged: Thank you. We marked it as sent.
help_neighbor_title: Help a neighbor who got a blue envelope
help_neighbor_body: Share Blue Envelope with someone who needs it. Core help is always free — this is just a thank-you.
share_msg: I used Blue Envelope to understand my MassHealth letter and get my papers ready. It is free and in six languages. Try it:
show_me_board: Show my first name and town on the Community Board
ref_shared_anon: A neighbor shared this with you
community_label: Actions in Blue Envelope. MassHealth records are not visible to us.
community_goal: toward 360,000 members who may face the new rules
community_ranking: Towns by neighbors helped per 1,000 residents
rts_built: Your packet is ready. It was made on your phone — nothing was uploaded.
rts_fill: Fill these in on my phone (optional)
rts_privacy: Your name and Member ID are written into the PDF only. They are never sent anywhere or saved.
rts_recipients: Send to: yourself (to print), your health center navigator, or a family member.
rts_official_online: Upload in your MassHealth online account
rts_official_mail: Mail to the address on your letter
rts_official_fax: Fax to the number on your letter
rts_official_center: Take it to your health center
rts_official_note: Send it the way your letter says. If your letter lists an email address, you can use that.
rts_sent_done: MassHealth will review it. Check your account in about 10 days.
